Each card below was written from one document, in answer to the same question. Sort the cards into groups.

Question: In which state is the Haymarket District located?

Card 1 (from document 1)
  entity: Haymarket District
  sense: not stated
  answer: Lincoln, Nebraska
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "Haymarket District (Lincoln, Nebraska) "For other subjects known by a similar name see Haymarket District" Haymarket District is a historic section of downtown Lincoln, Nebraska."
Card 2 (from document 2)
  entity: Haymarket District
  sense: not stated
  answer: Lincoln, Nebraska
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "Haymarket District ( Lincoln , Nebraska )"
Card 3 (from document 3)
  entity: Haymarket Historic District
  sense: not stated
  answer: Kalamazoo, Michigan
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "The Haymarket Historic District is a historic area in Kalamazoo, Michigan."
Card 4 (from document 6)
  entity: Haymarket District
  sense: not stated
  answer: Council Bluffs, Iowa
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "Haymarket Commercial Historic District is a nationally recognized historic district located in Council Bluffs, Iowa, United States."
Card 5 (from document 7)
  entity: The Haymarket Commercial Historic District
  sense: not stated
  answer: Council Bluffs, Iowa
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "It was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1985 . [ 1 ] At the time of its nomination the district consisted of 28 resources , including 19 contributing buildings , and"
Card 6 (from document 8)
  entity: Haymarket Commercial Historic District
  sense: not stated
  answer: Council Bluffs
  as of: not stated
  evidence: "located in the administrative territorial entity Council Bluffs 1 reference stated in National Register of Historic Places"

Sort in three layers:
1. Entity. Cards about the same real-world thing go together. A shared name is not enough, because different people, places and works can have the same name: go by the identifying details (what kind of thing, role, place, years, other names). Cards that describe one thing in different words go together. Cards with the same identifying details go together even when their answers differ.
2. Sense. Inside an entity, cards about the same event, edition, version, condition, place or measure go together. Cards whose sense is "not stated" go in a sense named "not stated".
3. Answer. Inside a sense, cards with compatible answers go together: the same answer in other words or at another precision, such as "December 2009" and "18 December 2009". Answers that differ go in separate groups, whichever you believe is right.

Reply with JSON only, in this form, where each list of numbers is one group of cards with compatible answers:
{"entities": [{"name": "", "senses": [{"name": "", "answers": [[1, 2], [3]]}]}], "uncertain": []}

"name" of an entity: its full name with the details that identify it.
"uncertain": the numbers of the cards that could belong to more than one entity.
Every card number appears exactly once under "answers".
